title: Toronto Marathon 2026
description: 8-week hybrid training block combining strength work with marathon-specific running. Targeting sub-3:20 at the May 3, 2026 race.

days.training: Long Run: 30 km (10 easy + 15 @ MP + 5 easy)

title: Hybrid Month Split
description: 4-week hybrid block: 3 gym sessions and 3 runs per week. Build strength and aerobic base simultaneously.

title: Fat Loss 6 Weeks
description: 6-week fat loss program: 3 gym sessions and 3 treadmill sessions per week. High-intensity work to maximize calorie burn.

title: Marathon 10-Week Split
description: 10-week focused marathon training block. Pure running plan targeting sub-3:30 finish with progressive long run build-up.

title: Fat Loss 9 Weeks
description: 9-week structured fat loss plan: 2 gym sessions, 3 treadmill sessions, and 1 active recovery day per week. Sustainable, effective, and science-backed.

days.training: Active recovery — yoga or walk 5 km

title: Bulk Program 12 Weeks
description: 12-week muscle-building program. Progressive overload with 4-day gym split designed to maximize lean mass gains.

title: Strength Recomp 8 Weeks
description: 8-week body recomposition program. 4 gym sessions per week with strategic active recovery days. Build muscle while shedding body fat.

title: Half Marathon 8 Weeks
description: 8-week half marathon training plan. 4 runs per week progressing from 30 km to 50 km weekly volume, targeting sub-1:50.

title: Beginner 5K — 6 Weeks
description: 6-week beginner running program to complete your first 5K. Run/walk intervals progressing to continuous 5K. Zero experience needed.

title: Upper/Lower 4-Day Split
description: 4-week foundational upper/lower body split. 4 gym sessions per week, ideal for intermediate lifters building balanced strength.

title: Endurance + Strength 8 Weeks
description: 8-week hybrid endurance and strength program. 3 runs and 2 full-body gym sessions per week. Build a strong, capable body for any challenge.

title: Spartan Beast 5-Week Prep
description: 5-week Spartan Beast preparation program. Combines trail running, hill repeats, heavy strength & carries, and full OCR simulation circuits. Built to finish race day strong.

days.training: 6–8 km easy run + 15 min incline walk + mobility & sauna
Strength + Carries: trap bar DL 4×5, Bulgarian split squat 3×10, pull-ups 4 sets, DB press 3×10, farmer carries + dead hangs
Hill Intro: 8 × 60 sec uphill, walk/jog down, 50 walking lunges
Spartan Circuit 4 rounds: 800m run, 15 burpees, 10 pull-ups, 20 box step-ups, 40m carry, dead hangs
5–6 km recovery run + 20 min incline walk + sauna
Strength + Carries: deadlift, walking lunges, step-ups, pull-ups, heavy carries, towel grip work
Hill Session: 10 × 90 sec uphill + controlled downhill
Spartan Conditioning 5 rounds: 1 km run, 15 burpees, 15 KB swings, 10 pull-ups, crawl + carry
Hamilton Elevation Run #1 — 16–18 km trails with climbing
Heavy Spartan Strength: DL 5×5, step-ups 4×12, weighted pull-ups, heavy carries, core work
Long Hill Repeats: 5 × 4 min uphill + jog down recovery
Beast Simulation 6 rounds: 1 km run, 20 burpees, pull-ups, carries, lunges, dead hangs, crawl
18–21 km trail run — every 4 km: 20 lunges + 10 burpees
Moderate Strength: reduced volume, focus carries + pull-ups
Downhill Durability: 6 × 2 min uphill + faster downhill return
Final Spartan Simulation 4–5 rounds: run + burpees + carries + grip
Hamilton Elevation Run #2 — 14–16 km controlled trail run
